manifest_title: Stage 5C2 Complete Catalog Visual Asset & Description Manifest
asset_disclosure: All draft visual assets depicted herein are AI-generated concept renders created for visual planning and catalog design review. They do NOT represent physical stock or confirmed supplier inventory. Active existing catalog assets represent currently deployed storefront media.
storage_policy: All draft concept renders (JPG masters and WebP derivatives) reside strictly in docs/assets/drafts/ outside public/. No draft images are bundled into the client build or mapped into live products.ts.
markup_policy: Proposed Selling Price = Verified Source Sale Price * 1.05 for new reference items (5% markup rounded to nearest PKR; existing items retain authoritative catalog prices).
moq_formula: Packaging MOQ = min(25, max(1, ceil(5000 / proposed_selling_price)))
lead_time_policy: Minimum 10 calendar days after final design approval and receipt of the required advance payment; courier transit time is separate.

copy_compliance_rules.leak_resistance_purged: The term 'leak-resistant' has been removed from all customer-facing Tabarruk copy pending lab/physical sample testing.
copy_compliance_rules.food_claims_purged: Unsupported food claims (including 'Gilgit almonds', 'saffron-infused Jordan almonds', and 'single-origin fillings') have been eliminated.
copy_compliance_rules.custom_fillings_policy: Candies, chocolates, panjeeri, and non-catalog confectionery are presented strictly as customer-requested options subject to AllBarka team sourcing confirmation and quote.
copy_compliance_rules.zamzam_separation: Zamzam bottles/flasks are empty containers intended solely for customer-provided water; AllBarka never supplies or pre-fills Zamzam water.
copy_compliance_rules.technical_fields_separation: Unconfirmed physical engineering specs (board GSM, tinplate gauge, acrylic sheet thickness) are segregated into internal metadata and excluded from customer copy.

summary_counts.acrylic_shortfall_note: Personalized Acrylic Boxes has an explicit 4-product shortfall against the 6-product target. Exactly 2 products exist in the verified roster (1 existing + 1 verified reference). 3 proposed concepts remain separated in Group D as unverified concepts.
